name: Task 1 Demo Rules
description: Small user-supplied rule set for the Task 1 agentic-system demo.

rules.title: Cash to close must not exceed 19000 USD
rules.description: Flag source-backed cash-to-close values greater than USD 19,000. Cite the exact source value used.

definition.instruction: Only create a finding when a grounded current-source cash-to-close value is greater than 19000 USD. Do not invent missing values.

rules.title: Loan amount must be grounded in the source pile
rules.description: The report must have a source-backed loan amount rather than infer one from unrelated numbers.

definition.instruction: Create a finding only if no current source supports a loan amount.
